HZRD//Skillet for Resolume
Analog NTSC video as a Resolume effect: 156 looks from videoskillet,
playable from a MIDI controller.

WHAT YOU NEED
  - Windows 10 or 11
  - Resolume Arena or Avenue 7 or newer
  - Any GPU from roughly the last ten years

INSTALL
  1. Quit Resolume.
  2. Copy HZRD-Skillet.dll and HZRD-Skillet-Mixer.dll into
       Documents\Resolume Arena\Extra Effects
     (or Documents\Resolume Avenue\Extra Effects).
     Create the folder if it isn't there.
  3. Upgrading from Skillet NTSC 1.0.0? Delete SkilletNTSC.dll and
     SkilletNTSC-Mixer.dll from that folder. The new plugins replace them;
     your compositions and favorites carry over.
  4. Start Resolume.

USE IT
  - Effect: drag "HZRD//Skillet" from the Effects browser onto a layer or clip.
  - Mixer: on a layer, open Blend Mode and pick "HZRD//SkilletMix". It can
    use the layers below as Source A or B.
  - Pick a look from Preset, or step through with Prev / Next / Random.
  - Add favorite stars the look that's up; Favorites and Fav prev / next /
    random then play only your starred looks. Favorites are kept in
    Documents\HZRD-Skillet-favorites.txt.

AUDIO
  In the Audio group, set Audio input to "Computer audio (what's playing)"
  to react to whatever your computer plays, or choose a microphone, line in
  or audio interface. Then turn up Kick > roll, Kick > bloom, Level > tear
  or the Wave knobs. The Audio meter shows that sound is arriving.

MIDI
  Shortcuts > Edit MIDI, click any control, then move the pad, knob or fader
  on your controller. Good first mappings: Pad 1-16 to your pads, Prev / Next
  / Random / Fav next to buttons, Amount and the Perform knobs to faders.

IF NOTHING HAPPENS
  Open the effect's Status field: it says what went wrong. The same text is
  written to Documents\HZRD-Skillet-log.txt.

Full control reference: README.md in this folder.

Free to use. Port of videoskillet by Colin Diesh (MIT License); see LICENSE
and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
